hero.title: The work behind the facade.
hero.subtitle: Facade is one shared place for a small team: projects with pages you write on at the same time, and the conversation right beside them. Open source, Danish and in the EU.
hero.trust: AGPL-3.0 · Passkeys and two-factor sign-in · Your data out in one click

values.aiBody: Pages update as you write, and the conversation sits beside the work instead of in another app. The AI can suggest text, but a person puts it in.
values.dataBody: The whole workspace can be downloaded as Markdown, a spreadsheet and JSON in one click, and deleted completely again.
values.securityBody: Workspaces are separated in the database, not just in the code. Passkeys, two-factor sign-in and a log that cannot be edited.

family.body: Facade is one tool in the Haij family of open source tools for organizations that want to own their own technology.

demo.title: Try it without creating anything
demo.body: You get your own workspace with a project under way and two made-up colleagues: pages, a channel, threads and something in the inbox. It is deleted after {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. No email, no sign-up.
demo.privacy: Do not put real personal data in the demo. It passes through a database and possibly a language model on the way.

features.pages: Projects with pages and subpages in a tree

features.search: Search across everything, history and a trash

dataExport.privacy: The export holds the workspace's whole content and history. Passwords, passkeys and keys are not in it.
dataExport.mdBody: A zip file with a folder per project, a file per page, the channels as text and every file. It opens without Facade, and it is the one you will want to read in ten years.

ai.title: AI
ai.subtitle: Which engine answers, and what it is allowed to do.
ai.providerHint: The installation sets a model in the environment, and each workspace can choose its own instead.

model.title: Your own language model
model.subtitle: This workspace can run on a different model than the installation set up. Choose nothing and you inherit the installation's.
model.providerHelp: The Ollama address is set by the installation. That is deliberate: a workspace that could point at an address of its own would make the server fetch from anywhere.
model.modelHelpMistral: Leave the field empty to use {placeholder}.
model.modelHelpOllama: The name must match a model you have pulled with “ollama pull”. Test the connection above and it will list the ones you have.
model.keyHelp: Leave the field empty to use the installation's key. The key is encrypted before it is stored and cannot be read back.
model.keyStoredHelp: This workspace has its own key. Type a new one to replace it, or remove it to fall back on the installation's.
model.saveFailed: Could not be saved. Try again.
model.notAllowed: Only owners and administrators can change the workspace's model.

ai.setupIntro: Facade is a chat and cannot answer without a model. Set one up:
ai.setupOutro: Then start Facade again. Without a model the writing field says so, and settings, roles and tasks can still be edited.
ai.limitsHint: A model call costs money on a hosted installation and minutes on a local one. The numbers are generous for a person and mean for a script.
ai.messageLength: Characters in a message, at most
ai.principleDecides: The AI answers, the person decides. The model writes an answer; it never sends anything out of the house, never deletes anything and changes nothing unless you do.
ai.principleUndo: A suggestion from the model reaches the page only when you say yes, and the history can undo it.
ai.principleData: What you write, and what your documents contain, is sent to the model as data, never as instructions. The system prompt and the roles live on the server, where the administrator sets them.
ai.principleSovereign: The model can be swapped, including for a local one. Who can see what is listed in docs/subprocessors.md.
ai.testPatience: A local model may have to be read off disk first. That can take up to a minute the first time.
ai.failAuth: The key was rejected. Check the workspace's own key below, or the installation's MISTRAL_API_KEY.
ai.failUnreachable: Nothing is listening at that address. Is Ollama running? Check OLLAMA_BASE_URL.
ai.failConfig: The model is set up wrong. Correct the model name below, or LLM_MODEL in .env.
ai.failGeneric: The call failed. The details are below and in the server log.
ai.failRateLimited: Mistral refused the call as too many (429). The key works, but the account or plan sets the ceiling: on the free Experiment plan this happens often when the model is busy, and a key under a workspace with no active plan gets the same answer. Check Billing and Limits on console.mistral.ai for the organisation the key belongs to.
ai.failWhereToLook: The details are in the server log.
ai.testNotAllowed: Only the owner or an administrator can test the connection.
ai.withoutBody: Without a model everything else works: pages, channels, search and export. Only the suggestion buttons are gone.
ai.perInstallation: Calls across the installation per day
ai.failCeiling: Facade's own ceiling on AI calls was reached, not the provider's. The ceilings are under “Ceiling on AI calls” below; the installation's own is set with AI_DAILY_CALL_CAP. Try again shortly.

terms.title: Terms and privacy
terms.intro: Facade is an open source tool for working together, run by Haij. This is the agreement, short and in plain words.

what.title: What Facade is
what.body: One shared place for a small team: projects with pages written on together, and channels for the conversation.

account.title: Accounts and access
account.body: You get in by applying or being invited. We store your name, your email and your workspace's name, and use them to sign you in and to write to you about the service. Passwords are stored hashed, and you can add a passkey and two-factor. We sell nothing, and we do not send marketing you did not ask for.

yourData.title: Your data
yourData.body: Everything you write in Facade belongs to you and your workspace. It can be downloaded as a spreadsheet and JSON in one click and deleted again. We do not look at it unless you ask us for help, and we never pass it on.

ai.title: AI
ai.body: If a language model is set up and you ask for a suggestion, the page's text or the channel's latest messages are sent to the model. The model is Mistral in the EU or one on the installation's own server, and nothing is sent until you ask.

leaving.title: Leaving
leaving.body: You can delete your workspace immediately, without writing to anyone and without waiting. The export is one click away and readable without Facade. We keep no copy afterwards beyond the nightly encrypted backups, which roll off after 30 days — on the server and in the EU storage they are copied to.

availability.title: Operation and guarantees
availability.body: Facade is new, and there is no uptime guarantee. We look after your data with encrypted backups every night, but you should download an export now and then. The service is provided as is, without guarantees beyond what mandatory law requires.

license.title: Licence
license.body: The code is AGPL-3.0. You may use it, change it and run it yourself; if you change it and offer it to others over a network, your changes must be available too. What you write in the tool is not covered by the licence — that is yours.

demo.title: The demo
demo.body: A demo workspace is created without e-mail or sign-up and deleted entirely after 24 hours, account included. Do not put real personal data in it. We keep only the technical log data needed to keep the demo running.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Write to martin@vintherconsulting.dk. If you have found a security problem, SECURITY.md in the repository says how to report it; use that rather than an ordinary email.

help.closing: Something missing here? Write to us, or fix the page yourself: the code is open.

projects.title: Projects and pages
projects.body: A project holds pages and has its own channel. Pages can sit under other pages as deep as you like. Drag a page in the menu to move it, or choose Move in its menu. Subpages come along.

writing.title: Writing on a page
writing.body: Type / to choose a heading, task list, table, image or a link to another page. Select text to make it bold or add a link. Drag an image onto the page, or paste it from the clipboard.

together.title: Writing together
together.body: Everybody can write on the same page at the same time. You see each other's cursors and everything saves itself. If the connection drops it says Not saved yet and Facade keeps trying; leave the tab open until it is back. Ctrl/⌘+Z undoes your own changes, not your colleague's.

talk.title: Channels and threads
talk.body: Every project has a channel, and you can create more. Reply in a thread to keep a subject together. Type @ to mention somebody. Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line. Everybody in the workspace can read every channel; there are no private messages.

pageTalk.title: A conversation on a page
pageTalk.body: The Conversation button opens a conversation that belongs to the page. Whoever has taken part hears when others write.

inbox.title: Inbox and search
inbox.body: The inbox gathers what is aimed at you: when somebody mentions or answers you. ⌘K or Ctrl+K searches every page and message from anywhere.

history.title: History and trash
history.body: While you write, a version is kept at most every ten minutes. Under History you can see them and restore one; that happens as an ordinary change, so it can be undone too. A deleted page stays in the trash with everything under it until somebody deletes it for good. An archived project is found in the same place.

roles.title: Who may do what
roles.body: Every member can read and write everything in the workspace. Owners and admins invite and remove members under Settings → Workspace. Messages can only be edited and deleted by whoever wrote them.

ai.title: AI
ai.body: With a language model set up, the Suggestions button can summarize the page, find what is missing, keep writing or make a selection clearer, and What happened? catches you up on a channel. The AI never writes on its own: a suggestion reaches the page only when you ask, and the history can undo it. Without a model everything else works.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Under Settings → Data the whole workspace can be downloaded as Markdown with pages, files and conversations, as a spreadsheet and as JSON. One page can be downloaded as Markdown from its menu. The owner can delete the workspace completely.

agents.title: Agents
agents.body: Under Settings → Agents, owners and admins can give an AI agent such as Claude Code access through MCP. The agent becomes a member with its own name, can be mentioned with @ and can read everything. With write access it can create and change pages and write messages, and a version is kept before every change. It can never delete, invite or export. What the agent reads is sent to the model it runs on.
